statements.t: “As a result of our portfolio’s continued strong performance, we are raising both same-center NOI and FFO guidance for the second time this year.

We have also raised attractively priced capital, generating more than $101.3 million of gross proceeds at our share from asset sales year-to-date, including Hammock Landing, York Town Center and Old Hickory Mall, as well as the sale of land parcels at CoolSprings Galleria, Harford Mall and Friendly Center to multi-family developers for densification projects.
Management now anticipates same-center NOI for full-year 2026 in the range of 0.75% to 2.25%.

Properties excluded from the same-center pool that would otherwise meet these criteria are properties which are under major redevelopment or being considered for repositioning, where we intend to renegotiate the terms of the debt secured by the related property or return the property to the lender.
The Company intends to cooperate with the foreclosure or conveyance of the property in satisfaction of the debt.
The Company anticipates returning the property to the lender.

We exclude properties which are under major redevelopment or are being considered for repositioning, and where we are working or intend to work with the lender on a restructure of the terms of the loan secured by the property or convey the secured property to the lender (“Excluded Properties”).
